about: Ciao! I'm Mattia, a Computer Science Master's student at the University of Bari. My work spans VLM distillation, hybrid RAG architectures, and, since plain NLP wasn't enough, teaching language models to solve funny games like crosswords. I thrive at the intersection of deep learning, natural language processing and computer vision, always curious about the next hard problem.
tagline: Master's Degree Computer Science Student — Software Developer — AI Engineer

education.thesis: A Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipeline Combining Structured Records and Knowledge Graphs for Public Procurement. Combines SQL retrieval over 103M+ ANAC records with graph-based retrieval over procurement documents, evaluated on 40 questions across 18 tenders.

Supervised Learning Techniques for Semantic Segmentation of Aerial Images of Agricultural Fields. 3-month research internship at CILab under Prof. Gennaro Vessio, comparing CNN and Transformer architectures on the CVPR 2024 Agriculture-Vision Challenge (~50k images).

publications.title: Weather-Aware Multimodal Sensor Fusion for Robust Perception
publications.note: Camera-radar fusion for vehicle detection under adverse weather on the RADIATE dataset, part of the UIS Research Centre's Students for Italy's Future project.

publications.note: Fine-tuned Italian T5 with length-constrained generation and a CSP-based grid solver: MRR 0.63, 34% full-grid accuracy.

projects.name: Tender Copilot: Hybrid Graph-RAG for Public Procurement
projects.desc: Master's thesis project. Ingests national ANAC Open Data (103M+ records across 23 tables) together with tender PDFs parsed via Docling OCR. Builds an open-schema knowledge graph (AutoSchemaKG) through a 3-pass LLM pipeline, then answers questions by coupling deterministic relational scoping (SQLite FTS5 + Text-to-SQL) with a HippoRAG2-style graph retriever using Personalized PageRank and cross-encoder reranking. Runs fully local with open-weight LLMs served through LM Studio and Open WebUI in Docker.

projects.name: Cuelight
projects.desc: Present a PDF together: everyone in the room can change slides, point, draw and react, and every screen follows live. Presenters can lock the slides, and a presenter view shows the next slide, speaker notes, timer and pace. A small self-hosted Node.js server over WebSockets, with no accounts or database.

projects.name: Look Where It Matters: Distilling Vision Through Explanations
projects.desc: Explored whether Grad-CAM explanations improve knowledge distillation from Qwen2.5-VL-3B into a ViT student. Compared 7 distillation variants — global MSE baseline vs explanation-weighted losses with mean/attention/cross-attention probes. Built a blind-comparison arena (React/Express) with 3 local VLM judges for qualitative evaluation on 500 Mini-ImageNet images, plus BERTScore and LLM-as-a-judge automated metrics.

projects.name: End-to-end Code Comment Classification
projects.desc: Production-grade multi-label classification system categorizing code comments across Java, Python, and Pharo. Built end-to-end MLOps pipeline: DVC data versioning → CatBoost + SetFit dual-model training → MLflow experiment tracking → containerized FastAPI deployment with Gradio frontend. Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, sub-2s inference latency, 92.7% test coverage, published on HuggingFace Spaces with automated CI/CD.

projects.name: Quantum Contrastive Learning
projects.desc: Hybrid classical-quantum framework for contrastive representation learning on MNIST, inspired by SimCLR. Classical encoders (ResNet-18, lightweight CNN) feed variational quantum projection heads (Tensor Ring, MERA) trained with NT-Xent loss, followed by linear evaluation on the frozen encoder features.

projects.name: Temporal Link Prediction on Social Networks
projects.desc: Forecasted future social connections in the Gab network using Evolving Graph Convolutional Networks (EvolveGCN). Integrated 768-dim BERT embeddings from user posts as node features, trained incrementally across 6 temporal snapshots. Evaluated 4 experiment configurations varying learning rate and negative sampling, with GPU-accelerated metrics (cuDF/cuGraph) and t-SNE/UMAP embedding analysis.

projects.name: Corporate Credit Rating Prediction
projects.desc: Predicted corporate credit ratings (4 consolidated risk classes from 22 original categories) using RandomForest, XGBoost, and LightGBM. Tackled severe class imbalance with SMOTE, ADASYN, SMOTETomek, and SMOTEENN. Built a Bayesian Network with pgmpy for probabilistic inference on missing data. Achieved 86% balanced accuracy, evaluated with Cohen's Kappa and Geometric Mean.
